changes: Keep pending pipeline dispatch retirement tickets independent of mutable indirect-input encoding holds.
Retain original named backing while delayed dispatches record; skip stale raw bindings with an empty segment while preserving first-submission refusal and replay semantics.
Keep old backing through reencode turns and retire detached texel-buffer views with their backing.
lifetime_hardening.interpretation: The final view-only controls also passed against the older runtime. These runs exercise cold pending recording, replacement and detached refusal, but do not establish a failing-old/passing-new reproduction of the source-reviewed lifetime concern. Detached refusal can still prepare an epoch and submit batch synchronization; the observed output reports actual queue/epoch work and readback separately while requiring unchanged output texels, padding, ordinary files and zero delta scatter.
